verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no dedicated data-export or portability feature. A user could still pull data out programmatically: transactions can be listed with filters and retrieved individually via the REST v2 API, SDKs and MCP tools, so leaving is possible only through custom API work. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account export, explicit open-format outputs (e.g. CSV/JSON dumps), export coverage for nexus, certificate and settings data, offboarding or data-portability documentation, and independent corroboration.
